mainEntity.name: Are there any contraindications or safety considerations for practicing breathwork?

acceptedAnswer.text: While breathwork is generally safe, certain conditions warrant caution. Individuals with severe cardiovascular conditions, uncontrolled high blood pressure, epilepsy, or a history of panic attacks should consult a healthcare professional before starting. Pregnant individuals or those with recent injuries should also inform their instructor. At Cave Training, we encourage open communication about your health history so we can modify techniques or advise if certain practices are unsuitable, ensuring a safe and effective experience.
acceptedAnswer.description: Inform your instructor and consult a healthcare professional if you have severe cardiovascular conditions, epilepsy, high blood pressure, or are pregnant, to ensure safe breathwork practice.
